units.description: Individual Shared Responsibility Penalty. Line 92. If you and your household had full-year health care coverage, check the box. See instructions. Medicare Part A or C coverage is qualifying health care coverage. If you did not check the box, see instructions.

units.description: Health Care Coverage Information. Do you want information on no-cost or low-cost health care coverage? By checking the "Yes" box, you authorize the Franchise Tax Board to share limited information from your tax return with Covered California. See instructions.
